items.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: Tommy was with her, Tom and Ed Thigpen. And Ed left in ‘72 because he had married

ctx.x: But you stuck with Tommy Flanagan for a number of years.

Well when I went with Ella, when first I went with Ella, Tommy was with her, and then when I went back in ‘71, Tommy was with her, Tom and Ed Thigpen. And Ed left in ‘72 because he had married and his wife had a baby, and they got — Bobby Durham I think it was. Yeah. And so I was Tommy, Tommy and me stayed until ‘76. Almost five years with Tommy during that period there. Yeah, ‘76 he left.
Does your family enjoy the kind of lifestyle and the kind of music you do?
